title: Geek Bar Pulse Mexican Mango Vape 15000 Puffs
description:
Geek Bar Pulse Mexican Mango Vape: Enthralling 15000 Puffs
Experience a voyage of senses with the ultimate in vaping innovation, the Mexican Mango Geek Bar Pulse 15000 Disposable Vape. With each draw, this disposable vaporizer creates an immersive tropical experience thanks to the rich flavor of luscious Mexican mangoes. With a whopping 15000-puff capacity and 16ml of 50mg nicotine strength e-liquid, this stylish and practical gadget provides a smooth and long-lasting combination of taste and performance. With its unique taste and long-lasting capacity, it redefines the vaping experience and is made for vapers who want unmatched quality and ease.
Profile of Mexican Mango Flavor
The Geek Bar Pulse 15000 Disposable Vape’s Mexican Mango flavor captures the sensation of luscious, succulent Mexican mangoes. This flavor profile gives a rich, real taste that delights the senses with a tinge of tropical flair and a seductive sweetness. With every draw, the flavor bursts out in a wave of sweet, fruity succulence, accented by a little tang that embodies the real essence of a properly ripened mango.
Additional Features
Prefilled Capacity: 14mL
Battery Capacity: 650mAh
Max Puffs: 15000
Nicotine Strength: 5%
Operation: Draw-Activated
Heating Element: Mesh Coil
Charging: Type-C Port
FAQ
What is the Mexican Mango Geek Bar Pulse 15000?
The Mexican Mango Geek Bar Pulse 15000 is a high-capacity disposable vape featuring the rich and sweet flavor of Mexican mangoes.
What makes the Mexican Mango flavor unique?
The Mexican Mango flavor delivers a burst of sweet, fruity succulence with a hint of tang, capturing the essence of ripe Mexican mangoes.
What are the key features of the Geek Bar Pulse 15000?
Key features include a 14mL prefilled capacity, mesh coil heating element, and draw-activated operation for ease of use.
What type of coil does the Geek Bar Pulse 15000 use?
It uses a mesh coil heating element, providing consistent flavor and smooth vapor production.
